sources.title: Model uses real image to train AI to look for fakes
sources.snippet: AI-generated images have become increasingly more sophisticated from early ones that showed humans with more than five fingers on a hand, making it even harder to determine if photos are authentic. A team of computer scientists in the McKelvey School of Engineering at Washington University in St. Louis has developed a model that learns to detect fake images by learning which are real.
